Home.heroTitle: Innovating the Future with  Artificial Intelligence
Home.heroDescription: Inova AI is a solution provider solving problems across daily life and industries with advanced technology—from the 'Sniff by Hatch' platform for pet families to hospital systems, GMP document automation, and industrial 'FEM & AI' optimization.
Home.coreDescription: We leverage AI to solve complex challenges across multiple industries.
Home.service1Desc: A revolutionary AI platform for early detection of health concerns through medical questionnaires used in hospitals and image analysis.
Home.service2Desc: An AI-assisted diagnostic system optimized for veterinary clinics to support accurate diagnoses.
Home.service3Desc: Optimizing pharmaceutical CSV workflows and automating the GMP documentation process.
Home.service4Desc: Integrating the Finite Element Method with AI to accelerate industrial design and simulation accuracy.
Home.service5Desc: Deploying intelligent AI agents to improve inefficient workflows and maximize productivity.

Automation.heroDescription: Optimize your business processes with intelligent AI agents. Reduce repetitive tasks and focus on what matters most.
Automation.feature1Desc: We build customized AI agents that intelligently handle repetitive tasks.
Automation.feature2Desc: We analyze inefficient workflows and automate them in the most efficient way.
Automation.feature3Desc: We monitor automated task performance in real-time and provide analytical reports.
Automation.swingMateDesc: A social matching app for screen golf. Create or join rooms, and find playing partners through real-time chat.
Automation.csoDesc: An automated management program for CSO (Chief Safety Officer) operations. AI handles safety inspections, report generation, and compliance monitoring.
Automation.fieldWeatherDesc: A round-day weather app for golf courses. It shows rain and temperature for your tee-time window at a glance, based on the Korea Meteorological Administration's short-term forecast.

Footer.description: From veterinarians to simulation experts, specialists from entirely different fields collaborate without boundaries—a boundary-breaking startup obsessively exploring the new possibilities of AI to resolve complex industrial challenges.

About.heroDescription: As an AI-native startup, we redefine pet healthcare. We also encourage AI adoption in the pharmaceutical and manufacturing industries, bridging the gap to support professional-grade work across all sectors.
About.missionDesc1: Detecting health issues early is the key to longevity. We believe every pet owner deserves access to immediate, accurate health insights without waiting for an appointment.
About.missionDesc2: By combining advanced computer vision with the knowledge of experienced veterinarians, we create a safety net that never sleeps.
About.vetLedDesc: Co-founded by a practicing veterinarian (DVM) to ensure clinical validity in every algorithm we build.
About.petCentricDesc: Everything we build focuses on increasing industrial efficiency, minimizing stress and maximizing effectiveness.
About.journeyNowDesc: Launch of Sniff by Hatch beta.
About.journeyNextDesc: Enhancing stability for veterinarians and pet owners.
About.journeyFutureDesc: Promoting global service plans targeting the US and Europe.

Technology.heroDesc: We combine state-of-the-art Computer Vision with Large Language Models to simulate a veterinary consultation.
Technology.cvDesc: Our fine-tuned CNN/Transformer hybrid models are trained on a proprietary dataset of dermatological and dental conditions in dogs and cats.
Technology.llmDesc: We use advanced LLMs to conduct dynamic medical interviews (anamnesis) and synthesize visual findings into a coherent report.
Technology.llmFeature2: Medical jargon translation for pet owners
Technology.backendDesc: Powered by FastAPI and microservices architecture to ensure low-latency responses and high availability.
Technology.privacyDesc: We adhere to strict data privacy standards. Images are processed anonymously where possible, and personal data is encrypted at rest and in transit.
Technology.patentSectionDesc: INOVA.AI has secured patents for our core technology, protecting our unique approach to combining biosignals with questionnaire data.
Technology.patentTitleEn: "AI-based Pet Health Assessment System using Questionnaire and Biosignals"

Sniff.heroDesc: Sniff by Hatch uses advanced visual recognition AI to monitor your pet's health. Simply take a photo and get instant insights into their well-being.
Sniff.step1Desc:
Please fill out the questionnaire first.
You can leave the parts you don't know blank.
Sniff.step2Desc:
Please take a clear photo of your dog/cat's eyes, teeth, skin, etc.
Even if you think the posture is unusual, please take a full-body photo.
Sniff.step3Desc: Our deep learning model analyzes the image to provide an instant health status report.
Sniff.whyDesc: We bridge the gap between home care and veterinary visits using state-of-the-art AI technology.
Sniff.feature1Desc: Our AI analyzes visual cues from photos (skin, teeth, wounds) and combines them with symptom history for accurate assessments.
Sniff.feature2Desc: Developed based on the clinical database of Greenbel Animal Medical Center and verified by practicing veterinarians to ensure medical relevance. Critical cases are flagged for immediate professional care.
Sniff.feature3Desc: Track your pet's health timeline. Detect subtle changes early before they become serious issues.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: InovaAI (hereinafter the "Company") complies with the Personal Information Protection Act and related laws and regulations, and established this Privacy Policy to protect the personal information of users (hereinafter "Users") who use the Sniff by Hatch application (hereinafter the "App").
section1List1: Basic Pet Info: Species (dog/cat), breed, date of birth/age, weight, gender, neutering status, etc.
Pet Living Info: Eating habits, living environment, other pets, vaccination and parasite prevention info, etc.
Health Questionnaire: Current symptoms, past/current illness and treatment history, guardian's concerns, etc.
Photos for Analysis: Pet photos uploaded directly by the user.
Device Information: OS type, app version, usage logs, and other minimal technical information to ensure service stability.

Payment Information: Payment authorization details and transaction history for paid service use (sensitive payment method information such as card numbers is processed directly by the payment gateway and not stored by the Company)
section1List2: Email Address and Nickname: For sending result reports, responding to inquiries, and service announcements.
Other information voluntarily entered by the user.
Privacy.section2Intro: The Company uses the collected information for the following purposes:
section2List: Pet health analysis and providing result reports
Providing analysis services using AI models such as Google Gemini, OpenAI GPT-4, etc.
Service quality improvement, statistical analysis, and error/failure response
Processing user inquiries and customer support
section3List: In principle, personal information is destroyed immediately once the purpose of collection and use is achieved.
Information necessary for service operation and analysis advancement is kept for up to 1 year from the date of collection and then destroyed.
If preservation is required by relevant laws, it will be kept only for the period specified by the law.
If a user directly requests deletion, it will be deleted without delay within the range permitted by law.
Privacy.section4Title: 4. Provision to Third Parties and International Transfer
Privacy.section4Text1: The Company does not provide personal information to third parties without the user's prior consent. However, exceptions may be made if there is a legal basis or a legitimate request from an investigative agency.
Privacy.section4Text2: Some information may be transferred to and stored on overseas servers for the use of the services below:
Privacy.section4Footer2: The Company complies with the terms and policies of these service providers, transmits and processes data only within the scope of service provision purposes, and takes necessary protective measures as required by law.
Privacy.section5Text: The Company may entrust some tasks to external companies as needed for service provision. In this case, personal information protection obligations are clearly defined through entrustment contracts in accordance with the Personal Information Protection Act.
section5TrusteeList: Korea PortOne Inc. — Electronic payment gateway (PG) services, payment processing and settlement
NHN KCP Corp. — Credit card payment processing and settlement agency
section6List: Personal information that has passed the retention period or reached the processing purpose is destroyed without delay according to internal policies.
Information in electronic file format is deleted using technical methods that make recovery impossible.
Paper documents are destroyed through shredding or incineration.
Privacy.section7Title: 7. User Rights and How to Exercise Them
section7List: Users can request access, correction, deletion, or suspension of processing of their personal information at any time.
Requests can be made through the in-app inquiry function or email (support@inovaai.ai).
The Company will take necessary measures without delay after verifying identity and will provide guidance if there are legal restrictions.
Privacy.section8Title: 8. Security Measures for Protecting Personal Information
Privacy.section8Intro: The Company takes the following measures for the safe processing of personal information:
section8List: Data protection through transmission section encryption (HTTPS/SSL, etc.)
Minimizing personal information handling personnel and managing access rights
Regular security checks and log monitoring
Preventing unauthorized access to systems and data
section9List: This app does not directly target children under 14 and provides services to guardians (adults).
If the Company becomes aware that personal information of a child under 14 has been collected, it will take measures to delete it immediately.
Privacy.section10Intro: The Company designates a Personal Information Protection Officer as below to handle inquiries related to personal information protection:
section11List: This policy may be modified according to changes in laws or service content.
Important changes will be noticed in advance through in-app or website announcements.
The modified policy takes effect from the date of implementation posted on the website.
Privacy.finalNote: This Privacy Policy was enacted on November 1, 2025, and amended on July 13, 2026. Any subsequent changes will be announced through the InovaAI website.

fieldweather.title: FieldWeather Privacy Policy
fieldweather.intro: This section applies to the FieldWeather application (“FieldWeather”). Sections 1 through 11 above concern the Sniff by Hatch application; the following applies to FieldWeather.
fieldweather.s1Title: 1. Personal information collected by the Company
fieldweather.s1Intro: FieldWeather has no sign-up or login. The Company does not collect or store on its servers any information that identifies a user, such as name, email address, phone number, or precise location.
s1List: Your list of favorite golf courses and cached forecasts are stored only on your device and are not sent to the Company's servers. They are deleted when you delete the app.

When the app retrieves forecasts, connection information such as your IP address may be temporarily logged by the server, as with ordinary internet traffic. The Company does not use this information to identify users.
fieldweather.s2Title: 2. Information collected by third parties for advertising
fieldweather.s2Intro: FieldWeather is free and uses Google's advertising service (Google AdMob) to display ads. In the course of displaying ads, Google may automatically collect and process the following information.
s2List: Device identifiers: advertising ID (Android advertising ID, iOS identifier for advertisers), app set ID
Approximate location: general area estimated from the IP address
App usage information: interactions with the app such as app launches and ad impressions and clicks
Diagnostic information: crash logs and diagnostic data such as performance
s2Notes: Purposes: displaying ads and measuring ad performance, analytics, and fraud prevention
Processor: Google LLC and its affiliates (data may be processed on servers outside Korea)
fieldweather.s3Intro: You can limit the information used for personalized ads in the following ways. Even if you do, all features of the app remain available and ads are shown in a non-personalized form.
s3List: Android: Settings → Google → Ads, then delete or reset your advertising ID
iOS: choose “Ask App Not to Track” in the tracking prompt shown when you first open the app, or change it in Settings → Privacy & Security → Tracking
In regions where consent is required, such as the European Economic Area, the app shows a consent screen on first launch, and you can change your consent at any time.
fieldweather.s4Title: 4. Retention, deletion, and provision to third parties
s4List: The Company does not hold personal information of FieldWeather users. Information stored on your device is deleted when you delete the app.

The Company does not provide users' personal information to third parties. However, as described in item 2, the Google advertising service included in the app collects information directly from the device to display ads, and its retention period follows Google's policies.
fieldweather.s5Text: FieldWeather is intended for users aged 18 and over and does not knowingly collect personal information from children.
fieldweather.s6Text: Forecasts in FieldWeather are an arrangement of the Korea Meteorological Administration's short-term forecast and may differ from actual weather.
fieldweather.s7Text: For inquiries about privacy in FieldWeather, please contact the privacy officer listed in Section 10 above.
fieldweather.finalNote: This FieldWeather section was established on November 18, 2026. Any future changes will be announced on the InovaAI website.

FemAi.heroDesc: Prepare STEP / BREP geometry, meshing settings and quality requirements in one workspace. InovaAI is building cloud-based automated mesh preprocessing for enterprise engineering teams.
FemAi.concept: WORKFLOW CONCEPT · NOT AN ENGINE RESULT
FemAi.notice: This is a UI preview. Files are not sent to a server. No meshing, billing or result generation takes place.
FemAi.flowDesc: From geometry preparation to quality review and solver-ready files. Focused on the steps before solver analysis.
FemAi.flow1: Element size · Hex priority / Tet only
FemAi.workspaceDesc: Review file selection and settings. Execution will be available after engine integration.
FemAi.uploadDesc: Single STEP / STP / BREP · up to 50 MiB
FemAi.localOnly: Local selection only · Server upload disabled
FemAi.fileCount: Select exactly one file at a time.
FemAi.fileType: Choose a STEP (.step/.stp) or BREP (.brep) file.
FemAi.fileLarge: The file must be 50 MiB (52,428,800 bytes) or smaller.
FemAi.extensionOnly: Only extension and size have been checked. CAD contents, geometry validity and units have not been validated.
FemAi.consent: I am authorized to review this material and will use only non-confidential test files for this UI preview.
FemAi.localPolicy: Only the selected file name, size and format are held in page memory. File contents are not read, stored or transmitted. Refreshing, removing the selection or resetting clears selection metadata.
FemAi.needFile: Select a file and confirm review authorization to configure settings.
FemAi.policyNowDesc: No CAD transmission or server storage. Job history and settings are not persisted.
FemAi.policyBeforeDesc: Encryption in transit and at rest, tenant access, processing region, retention, source/result deletion and backup deletion must be agreed in the contract and upload policy. These are not active capabilities.
FemAi.policyTrainingDesc: The adoption principle is no AI training on customer CAD by default, with a separate explicit consent process required before any such use. No CAD is collected in this preview.
FemAi.settingsDesc: Inputs are for local review only, not an execution request. Defaults are not performance recommendations or quality guarantees.
FemAi.unitHelp: The target element size is accepted in mm only. The engine reads STEP in mm; BREP carries no unit, so model coordinates are used as they are. No unit conversion is performed.
FemAi.hexHelp: Only supported shapes are meshed (boxes, cylinders, plates with through holes, constant-section extrusions, cone frustums, stepped shafts, …). Unsupported shapes end as a failure; there is no automatic switch to Tet.
FemAi.qualityHelp: Linear elements only. Quality is judged with the engine’s fixed criteria (Hex: Scaled Jacobian below 0.5 or Skew above 0.5; Tet: Scaled Jacobian below 0.1 gives a warning). Per-job quality targets are not supported.
FemAi.invalidSettings: Check the target element size (above 0, up to 100,000 mm).
FemAi.blockedDesc: You can review settings. No job has been submitted because the FEM 3.2 engine is not connected. No server queue, progress percentage or completion estimate has been created.
FemAi.run: Run auto meshing · Available after integration
FemAi.noResultsDesc: Results will appear here after actual meshing and quality validation. No customer CAD or simulated success result is displayed.
FemAi.metricNote: — means no measurement, or a value the engine does not provide. It does not mean zero or a pass. The engine does not compute an aspect ratio, so none is shown; the edge ratio (longest/shortest edge of an element) is a different metric.
FemAi.exportNote: Only jobs whose meshing actually completed (success or warning) can be downloaded.
FemAi.enterpriseDesc: Validate workflows and supported geometry in the cloud first, then define scope around your security requirements and processing volume.
FemAi.cloudDesc: Browser-based CAD → mesh preprocessing. Whether a run is possible and the engine connection state are shown in the workspace.
FemAi.pocDesc: Agree on supported CAD, quality targets, concurrency, volume and data policy. Pricing, processing time and success rates are not yet established.
FemAi.onpremDesc: On-premises delivery is a later priority. Initial scope focuses on cloud-based preprocessing.
FemAi.contactTitle: Explore the fit for your team’s CAD.
FemAi.contactDesc: For initial inquiries, describe formats, part types and quality needs without attaching CAD. Share actual files only after security and upload policies are agreed.
FemAi.metaDesc: Cloud-first automated STEP/BREP mesh preprocessing for enterprise analysis teams. Mesh settings, quality report, 3D preview and INP/MSH export.
FemAi.subscriptionRequiredDesc: You are signed in to your FEM account. Cloud meshing requires a FEM AI Pro subscription (KRW 50,000/month excl. VAT, 40 runs/month) on this FEM account. A Sniff account or a subscription to another service does not count as a FEM subscription. Subscription payment for FEM accounts is not available yet.
FemAi.quotaExceededDesc: You have used all 40 meshing runs for this month. Your quota resets on the next billing cycle.
FemAi.tetHelp: The whole solid is meshed with linear tetrahedra (C3D4). Assemblies (multiple solids) are not supported yet.
FemAi.workspaceDescLive: Select a file and run meshing to get a quality report, a 3D preview and INP/MSH files.
FemAi.localOnlyLive: Sent to the server when you press Run · not sent before that
FemAi.consentLive: I am authorized to upload this data and agree that it is sent to and processed on the server for meshing.
FemAi.localPolicyLive: Selecting a file sends nothing. When you run, the file is sent to the meshing server storage, and the original CAD is deleted when the job ends (success, failure or cancel). Result files can be downloaded for 24 hours after completion and are not offered after that; actual deletion happens in a later cleanup. File name, size, settings and quality metrics are kept as job history.
FemAi.settingsDescLive: Meshing really runs with the settings below. Defaults are not a recommendation or a quality guarantee.
FemAi.noticeLive: Cloud meshing is available with a FEM AI Pro subscription.
FemAi.noResultsDescLive: When meshing completes, the real mesh of that job is shown here. No concept drawing or sample result is shown in its place.
FemAi.policyNowDescLive: CAD is sent to the server when you run meshing. Original CAD is deleted when the job ends. Results are accessible for 24 hours after the job ends; physical deletion may occur later through a subsequent request or storage lifecycle rule. File names, settings and quality metrics remain in your FEM account history. Account history is deleted when your account-deletion request is processed. Request account deletion through the enterprise contact address.
FemAi.policyBeforeDescLive: Transfers use HTTPS and CAD/mesh files are held in private storage. This beta does not provide a dedicated enterprise environment or a separate retention agreement. Confirm your organization permits uploading confidential material before doing so.
FemAi.policyTrainingDescLive: The adoption principle is that customer CAD is not used for AI training by default, and any use requires a separate explicit consent process. There is currently no feature that uses uploaded data for training.
FemAi.engineUnreachableDesc: The meshing worker is not responding, so a run is not possible right now. Please check again shortly.
FemAi.engineReachable: Worker responding · no completed real mesh recorded
FemAi.engineVerified: Worker responding · a completed real mesh is recorded
FemAi.quotaUnknownDesc: This month’s usage could not be checked. A run is not possible until it can be.
FemAi.quotaRule: jobs the engine judged (success, warning, meshing failure) and timeouts count as one run; delivery failures and rejected submissions do not
FemAi.accessUnknownDesc: Sign-in, subscription and engine status could not be checked. A run is not possible until they can be.
FemAi.fixedThresholdNote: Quality verdict: fixed engine criteria (per-job targets not supported)
FemAi.thresholdNote: Fixed engine criteria applied to this job — Hex Scaled Jacobian min {hexSj}, Hex Skew max {hexSkew}, Tet Scaled Jacobian min {tetSj}. Elements outside them give a warning; degenerate or invalid elements make the job fail.
FemAi.noProgressNote: No percentage or estimated completion time is provided. Only the stage name recorded by the engine is shown. The job time limit is 180 seconds.
FemAi.err_SUBSCRIPTION_REQUIRED: A FEM AI Pro subscription is required.
FemAi.err_ENGINE_NOT_CONFIGURED: The engine is not connected. The job was not submitted.
FemAi.err_QUOTA_EXCEEDED: This month’s run limit has been used up.
FemAi.err_DELIVERY_FAILED: The job could not be delivered to the meshing worker (communication failure). Meshing did not run and it does not count toward your usage. Please try again.
FemAi.err_SUBMIT_REJECTED: The worker rejected the submission. Meshing did not run and it does not count toward your usage.
FemAi.err_UNSUPPORTED_SETTINGS: Unsupported settings. Only Hex priority or Tet only, linear elements and mm are available.
FemAi.err_INVALID_FILE: Please check the file. Only STEP/STP/BREP up to 50 MiB is accepted.
FemAi.err_UPLOAD_MISSING: The uploaded file was not found. Please try again.
FemAi.err_UPLOAD_FAILED: The file upload failed. Meshing did not run. Please try again.
FemAi.err_WORKER_JOB_MISSING: The worker no longer has this job. Please run it again.
FemAi.err_REQUEST_ALREADY_CLOSED: This request has already ended. Please run again.
FemAi.err_NETWORK_ERROR: The request could not be sent because of a network error. You can retry the same request.
FemAi.err_INTERNAL_ERROR: The request could not be processed. Please try again shortly.
FemAi.syncUnavailable: The current status could not be read from the worker. What is shown below is the last confirmed state and may be out of date.
FemAi.pollStoppedFailures: Status checks failed repeatedly, so automatic checking stopped. This does not mean the job failed.
FemAi.pollStoppedTimeout: The job did not finish after a long wait, so automatic checking stopped. This does not mean the job succeeded or failed.
FemAi.resultExpired: The retention period has passed or the result was deleted, so result files and the detailed report are no longer available. The metrics below are the values saved at completion.
FemAi.warningDesc: Mesh files were produced, but the engine warned about the following. Check before using the mesh for analysis.
FemAi.failureNoFiles: A failed job provides no mesh files and no preview.
FemAi.previewOmittedDesc: The mesh is too large to show a 3D preview. No simplified substitute was generated, and the INP/MSH files are unaffected.
FemAi.previewNotGenerated: This job has no preview data.
FemAi.previewError: The preview could not be shown
FemAi.previewErrorDesc: Loading or drawing the preview data failed. The INP/MSH files are unaffected.
FemAi.previewNote: The shape shown is the boundary surface of this job’s mesh (not simplified). Red faces belong to elements outside the quality criteria.
FemAi.exportNoteDone: These files are the real output the engine produced for this job. You can verify a download with the SHA-256 shown.
FemAi.expiryNote: Results available until {time}. They cannot be downloaded after that.
FemAi.solverNote: The INP passed file-structure validation only. No Abaqus solver run was performed.
FemAi.loginRequiredDesc: Uploading a file, running meshing, viewing jobs and downloading results require signing in to a FEM account. FEM AI uses its own FEM account (Google or Apple sign-in), separate from Sniff and other INOVA.AI services; being signed in to another service does not sign you in to FEM. If this is your first time, signing in creates your FEM account. Going to the sign-in screen does not keep the selected file, so please select it again after signing in.
FemAi.loginCta: Sign in with a FEM account
FemAi.authUnavailableDesc: FEM account sign-in is not available yet. Until it is, files cannot be uploaded and meshing cannot be run.
FemAi.err_FEM_AUTH_NOT_CONFIGURED: FEM account sign-in is not available yet.
FemAi.sessionExpired: The server refused the request because the sign-in expired or access is no longer permitted. Please sign in again. This does not mean the job failed.
FemAi.betaNotice: Free beta · Sign in to FEM for {limit} runs per month. No payment details required.
FemAi.betaHeroDesc: Upload STEP / BREP and set the element size. Run automatic meshing, inspect quality reports and a 3D preview, then download INP / MSH. Sign in to FEM for 40 free runs per month.

Pricing.femFeature1: Up to 40 cloud auto-meshing runs / month
Pricing.femFeature2: STEP / STP / BREP input (up to 50 MiB, mm units)

Pricing.disclaimer: Premium subscriptions are billed automatically every month. You can cancel at any time, and no further charges will be made from the next billing date after cancellation.

RefundPolicy.title: Paid Service Usage and Refund Policy
RefundPolicy.item1: Pricing: Sniff Premium KRW 3,300/month (VAT included), a recurring subscription product billed automatically each month.
RefundPolicy.item2: Cancelling the subscription: You can cancel yourself at any time from the Manage Subscription page after signing in, and requests are also accepted via customer support (support@inovaai.ai) 24 hours a day regardless of business hours. After you request cancellation you keep full access until the end of the month you have already paid for; no further automatic payment is taken from the next billing date, and the subscription ends at that point. You may undo the cancellation from the Manage Subscription page any time before that end date.
RefundPolicy.item3: No partial refund on early cancellation: This product is billed monthly with no minimum term and no early-termination penalty, so pro-rata refunds for cancelling mid-cycle are not provided.
RefundPolicy.item4: Cooling-off (withdrawal of subscription): We refund in full if you request it within 7 days of your first payment and have not used the service. However, once you have started using the service (for example, by running an AI analysis), the right of withdrawal may be restricted under Article 17(2) of the Act on Consumer Protection in Electronic Commerce.
RefundPolicy.item5: Company fault: Where the cause lies with the Company, such as a service outage or an incorrect charge, we refund regardless of the restrictions above.
RefundPolicy.item6: Refund method: Refunds are issued by cancelling the original payment where possible; otherwise they are paid in cash equivalent, such as a bank transfer. Refunds are never issued solely as points, cash credits, or other company-issued balances.
RefundPolicy.item7: Price changes and advance notice: If the recurring charge increases, or a free plan converts to paid, we notify you by email or in-service announcement at least 7 days before it takes effect, and you may cancel before then.
RefundPolicy.item8: Refund processing time: Valid refund requests are processed within 3 business days of receipt. The actual credit may be delayed depending on your card issuer or payment method.
RefundPolicy.item9: Misuse: Refunds may be restricted where misuse is confirmed, such as abuse of the refund process.
